cohort: 173 severe preeclamptic women undergoing emergency cesarean section
finding: Severe preeclamptic mothers receiving general anesthesia and their babies required more critical care support, and both maternal and neonatal mortality was significantly higher with general anesthesia.
mod_finding: Severe preeclamptic mothers receiving general anesthesia and their babies required more critical care support, and both maternal and neonatal mortality was significantly higher with general anesthesia.
